comment: Anchor table for the sdl→ji cutover plan. Paths are PRE-MV (as in the current tree); synthesis rewrites .sdl/→.ji/, sdl.toml→ji.toml, .pi/extensions/sdl.ts→ji.ts to post-mv form. Changeset membership is FIXED here — classifiers never assign changesets.

cs1-workspace-globs.why: Hard build breaker: the three configs must carry the byte-identical ../.ji/reviews/*/tools/* glob or pnpm install/tsgo fail. Lockfile excluded (regenerates).

cs2-manifest-key.why: The "sdl" manifest key renames through a typed Zod schema + diagnostic codes; per-file agents cannot see the schema contract. Owns the kernel bin key (kernel/package.json is a member anyway) and the style-guard path bucket (one owner per file).
cs2-manifest-key.notes: Rename the KEY "sdl"→"ji" (incl. sdl.tier) and diagnostic codes missing-sdl/extension_manifest_missing_sdl→ji variants (decided: everything is ji). Do NOT rename: schema/type identifiers (sdlExtensionManifestSchema etc. — later package-scope row), bare "sdl" VALUES in subpackages arrays (they name src/sdl/ dirs — later row), module-loader.ts src/sdl join literals, @sdl/* imports. kernel/package.json bin {"sdl"}→{"ji"}. api-boundary.test.ts: RENAME the manifest-key reads `.sdl.tier`, `readonly sdl:`, `"sdl" in value`, `value.sdl` to ji forms (they read the renamed key, NOT identifiers); LEAVE every sdl-flow token including the `"sdl-flow:land:capability"` assertion — that string derives from the surviving PACKAGE name, not the sdl:flow namespace.

cs3-repo-extension-discovery.why: Silent-failure trap (registry scans .sdl/extensions; miss = every repo-local command vanishes) + tests traversing the REAL post-mv .ji/extensions tree via relative URLs (ENOENT on split landing). One agent verifies resolution against the moved tree once.
cs3-repo-extension-discovery.notes: registry.ts:123,128 join(cwd, ".sdl", "extensions")→".ji"; also the XDG data/sdl/extensions global root via resolveSdlXdgPath is CS5's constant — registry only carries path segments here. extension-registry.test.ts fixtures: .sdl workspace paths, .local/share/sdl, unquoted sdl:{ manifest keys — all rename.

cs4-slot-path-regex.why: Highest-risk silent failure (prior real regression): isManagedSlotPath() regex + its positive/negative fixture families are a semantic pair — keep match semantics, not letter-swap. Owns ALL renames in its test files (one owner per file).
cs4-slot-path-regex.notes: worktrees.ts:74-76 sdl\/slots→ji\/slots. Test files also contain "sdl:flow:land" strings, /Users/me/.local/state/sdl/slots fixtures, TOPOLOGY assertions — this changeset renames all of them.

cs5-xdg-core.why: The canonical XDG segment and its known hand-rolled bypasses must land as one semantic unit so no bypass survives on the old segment. Third bypass (worktrees.ts regex) is cs4 — cross-referenced.
cs5-xdg-core.notes: xdg-path.ts:67 "sdl" segment→"ji" (identifier resolveSdlXdgPath STAYS); submit.ts:300-311 hand-rolled XDG + .sdl/state/submit-failure-logs cwd fallback + its /sdl:flow: message strings at :18-108 belong to the push.ts simple entry NOT here — submit.ts is wholly owned HERE, rename all its sdl content; aretro root.ts:16 tmpdir segment "sdl"→"ji" (Q4).

cs6-pi-namespace-core.why: Three namespace mechanisms with no shared source of truth, publicly exported constants, and a test asserting the exact name set + absence of legacy aliases (semantic, not literal). SPECIALIZED_SKILL_REPLACEMENTS KEYS are skill dir names — do not rename keys, only values.
cs6-pi-namespace-core.notes: piNamespace "sdl:flow"→"ji:flow"; surfaces.ts 6 constants + KNOWN_PI_COMMAND_NAMESPACES "sdl"→"ji" + replacement VALUES sdl:flow:*→ji:flow:*; events.ts "sdl:pi-extension-command:finished"→"ji:…" (Q4); sdl-extension.ts parity cli:/surface: template strings too; test intended post-state: exact set /ji:flow:*, absence assertions now mean the sdl:* names are the dead legacy — assert absence of sdl:flow:* names. Filenames (sdl-extension.ts) do NOT rename.

cs8-shim-tokens.why: The @@SDL_*@@ substitution tokens in the shim template and the TOKEN_PREFIX/replacement-map keys in the renderer are a semantic pair whose desync fails SILENTLY at install time (shim rendering runs outside the just gate). Promoted from classification suspectedNewCoupling.
cs8-shim-tokens.notes: Rename TOKEN_PREFIX "@@SDL_"→"@@JI_" and every @@SDL_TOOL@@/@@SDL_CANONICAL_CHECKOUT@@/@@SDL_CLI_REL_PATH@@/@@SDL_INSTALL_HINT@@/@@SDL_FALLBACK_MODE@@ token in BOTH files in lockstep; the SDL_FALLBACK_MODE env-var error string too; template brand prose ('runs an sdl TypeScript CLI') renames; the justfile SDL_* variable ASSIGNMENTS that feed this template are a separate simple entry (justfile) — the names must agree: JI_TOOL, JI_CANONICAL_CHECKOUT, JI_CLI_REL_PATH, JI_INSTALL_HINT, JI_TEMPLATE, JI_OUTPUT, JI_FALLBACK_MODE.

cs7-toml-readers.why: areg gateways.ts:279 declares a literal UNION TYPE "sdl.toml" that propagates through every assignment site; piecemeal change = typecheck noise per-file agents can't resolve.
cs7-toml-readers.notes: sdl.toml→ji.toml everywhere incl. the union type; identifiers sdlToml STAY. areg/roaster test fixtures asserting sdl.toml content are simple-tier (brief-decidable).

mvOnly.comment: Caller-owned git mv targets whose CONTENT needs no edit (all-survivor content). Not in the engine work-list; the runbook brackets own them.
mvOnly..pi/extensions/sdl.ts: git mv → .pi/extensions/ji.ts; content is sdl-flow package import + sdl-extension filename + sdlExtension identifier — all survivors

pathRules.skills/**/*.md: simple, skills cohort — sdl <cmd> instruction lines, /sdl:* references, .sdl/ paths, SDL_* env var names, and dotted manifest-field prose sdl.<field> (tier, commands, subpackages, clinkr.caps, …) all rename; SURVIVORS: skill DIRECTORY names (sdl-typescript, sdl-cli-design, sdl-flow-submit, …), @sdl/* specifiers, the sdl-tools repo name, src/sdl/ path segments, package names (sdl-flow, sdl-capability-kit, sdlcc); edit only skills/ (.agents/skills and .claude/skills are symlinks)
